news.analysis: Pickens has found his way to the end zone of late, scoring one or more touchdowns in three of his last five games. The wideout offers fantasy managers one of the more impactful pass-catching options ahead of a favorable Week 11 contest against the Tennessee Titans.

news.contents: Dallas Cowboys wide receiver George Pickens was seemingly unstoppable during Sunday's game against the San Francisco 49ers. Pickens missed last week's game against the Indianapolis Colts due to injury, but he returned with a bang this weekend. The 25-year-old hauled in 11 of his 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the loss. Pickens couldn't be kept out of the end zone, but sadly, it still wasn't enough to get his team the win. Pickens set a new season-high in receptions and yardage...
news.title: George Pickens Puts up Unbelievable Numbers in Loss

news.contents: Miami Dolphins wide receiver Malik Washington will be dealing with a new quarterback this week as Kyle McCord takes over for Malik Willis, who was placed on IR with a core injury. Washington and Willis worked well together, and Washington leads the team with 48 targets for the season. He has fallen behind Caleb Douglas a little bit in the last few weeks after Douglas returned from injury. Last week, Washington only had three targets and two catches for 21 yards against the Lions. news.analysis: One week after a tremendous, season-best performance, Boutte virtually disappeared from the box score Sunday afternoon. Boutte has made some plays for the Texans this season, including a pair of touchdowns in Week 9, but he's difficult to deploy in fantasy lineups due to an unreliable target share.

Barner's receiving volume remained low, as he only logged two receptions for seven yards and a touchdown. As long as Barner's volume remains that low, he will be extremely touchdown-dependent. The hope is that newly acquired Jacoby Brissett will help stabilize this offense against the Los Angeles Chargers' defense in Week 10. The former first-round pick of the 2023 draft has had a rough go this season, totaling a paltry 13 catches through seven appearances. It sounds like Darnold is making progress, so fantasy managers can be hopeful for his return following the Week 11 bye. The Virginia Tech product has not been as effective as Brian Robinson (hamstring) was as the team's secondary option at running back, and figures to have a limited role again in Week 10 in a home matchup against the Chiefs.
